questions.question: A number when increased by 100% gives 2760. The number is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Increased value = 2760

Increase percentage = 100%

**Formula Used:**

Original value × (1 + Increase percentage ÷ 100) = Increased value

**Calculation:**

⇒ Original value × (1 + 100 ÷ 100) = 2760

⇒ Original value × 2 = 2760

⇒ Original value = 2760 ÷ 2

⇒ Original value = 1380

**∴ The correct answer is 1380.**

questions.question: Pipe P can fill (2)/(9) part of a tank in 20 hours, and pipe Q can fill (5)/(9) part of the same tank in 10 hours. Both P and Q were kept open for 3 hours, then both were closed. Pipe R alone was then opened and it emptied the water in the tank in 8 hours. Pipes P, Q and R together can fill the empty tank in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Pipe P fills 2/9 of tank in 20 hours

Pipe Q fills 5/9 of tank in 10 hours

P and Q work for 3 hours

Pipe R empties remaining water in 8 hours

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

Time = Total Work ÷ Efficiency

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time for P to fill full tank = (20 × 9) ÷ 2

⇒ Time for P to fill full tank = 90 hours

⇒ Time for Q to fill full tank = (10 × 9) ÷ 5

⇒ Time for Q to fill full tank = 18 hours

⇒ Total tank capacity = LCM(90, 18) = 90 units

⇒ Efficiency of P = 90 ÷ 90 = 1 unit/hr

⇒ Efficiency of Q = 90 ÷ 18 = 5 units/hr

⇒ P + Q efficiency = 1 + 5 = 6 units/hr

⇒ Water filled in 3 hours = 6 × 3 = 18 units

⇒ R empties 18 units in 8 hours

⇒ Efficiency of R = 18 ÷ 8 = 2.25 units/hr

⇒ Combined efficiency of P + Q + R = 1 + 5 − 2.25

⇒ Combined efficiency = 3.75 units/hr

⇒ Time to fill tank = 90 ÷ 3.75

⇒ Time = 24 hours

**∴ Pipes P, Q, and R together can fill the empty tank in 24 hours.**

questions.question: M and N started a business. M invested ₹31,000 more than N for 2 months, while N invested for 7 months. M's share is ₹139 more than that of N, out of a total profit of ₹5,977. Find the capital contributed by M.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total Profit = 5977

M invests for 2 months

N invests for 7 months

M invests ₹31,000 more than N

M's share is ₹139 more than N's share

**Formula Used:**

Profit share ∝ Capital × Time

Difference in shares = (M's share − N's share)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let N's capital = x

⇒ M's capital = x + 31000

⇒ M’s investment ratio = (x + 31000) × 2

⇒ N’s investment ratio = x × 7

⇒ M:N = 2(x + 31000) : 7x

⇒ Total profit = 5977

⇒ Difference in shares = 139

⇒ Share difference corresponds to ratio difference:

⇒ Ratio difference = 2(x + 31000) − 7x

⇒ = 2x + 62000 − 7x

⇒ = 62000 − 5x

⇒ Total ratio = 2(x + 31000) + 7x

⇒ = 2x + 62000 + 7x

⇒ = 9x + 62000

⇒ Share difference / Total profit = Ratio difference / Total ratio

⇒ 139 / 5977 = (62000 − 5x) / (9x + 62000)

⇒ Cross multiply:

⇒ 139(9x + 62000) = 5977(62000 − 5x)

⇒ 1251x + 139 × 62000 = 5977 × 62000 − 5977 × 5x

⇒ 1251x + 8618000 = 370,574,000 − 29885x

⇒ 1251x + 29885x = 370,574,000 − 8,618,000

⇒ 31136x = 361,956,000

⇒ x = 361,956,000 ÷ 31136

⇒ x = 11,625

⇒ N’s capital = 11,625

⇒ M’s capital = 11,625 + 31,000

⇒ M’s capital = 42,625

**∴ The capital contributed by M is ₹42,625.**

questions.question: The sides of a right-angled triangle are x cm, (x + 2) cm and (x + 4) cm, respectively. If the area of the triangle is 24 cm² , find its perimeter (in cm).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of triangle = 24 cm²

Sides of triangle = x cm, (x + 2) cm, (x + 4) cm

**Formula Used:**

Area of right-angled triangle = 1/2 × base × height

Pythagoras theorem: (Hypotenuse)² = (Base)² + (Height)²

Perimeter = Sum of all sides

**Calculation:**

⇒ Area = 1/2 × x × (x + 2)

⇒ 24 = 1/2 × x × (x + 2)

⇒ 48 = x × (x + 2)

⇒ x² + 2x - 48 = 0

⇒ (x + 8)(x - 6) = 0

⇒ x = 6 (as x cannot be negative)

⇒ Sides = 6 cm, 8 cm, 10 cm

⇒ Perimeter = 6 + 8 + 10

⇒ Perimeter = 24 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 24 cm.**

questions.question: ABCD is a trapezium in which BC ∥ AD and AC = CD. If ∠ABC = 70° and ∠BAC = 62°, then what is the measure of ∠ACD (in degree)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

ABCD is a trapezium in which BC ∥ AD and AC = CD

∠ABC = 70°

∠BAC = 62°

**Formula Used:**

In triangle ABC: ∠ACB = 180° − (∠ABC + ∠BAC)

Angles on the same side of parallel lines are supplementary: ∠BAD + ∠ABC = 180°

∠CAD = ∠BAD − ∠BAC

In isosceles triangle ACD (AC = CD): ∠CAD = ∠ADC

Sum of angles in triangle ACD = 180°

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e62a0e64edfd3a474e6b29f547ae889344d55dc1535b5019a85e40660fde0445.png] 

⇒ ∠ACB = 180° − (70° + 62°)

⇒ ∠ACB = 180° − 132°

⇒ ∠ACB = 48°

⇒ ∠BAD = 180° − 70°

⇒ ∠BAD = 110°

⇒ ∠CAD = 110° − 62°

⇒ ∠CAD = 48°

⇒ ∠ADC = 48° (since AC = CD)

⇒ ∠ACD = 180° − (48° + 48°)

⇒ ∠ACD = 180° − 96°

⇒ ∠ACD = 84°

**∴ The correct answer is 84°.**

questions.question: The selling price of 40 books is equal to the cost price of 30 books. Find the loss or gain percentage.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling price of 40 books = Cost price of 30 books

**Formula Used:**

Profit or Loss % = [(Selling Price - Cost Price) ÷ Cost Price] × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let Cost Price of 1 book = ₹1

⇒ Cost Price of 30 books = ₹30

⇒ Selling Price of 40 books = ₹30

⇒ Selling Price of 1 book = ₹30 ÷ 40 = ₹0.75

⇒ Loss per book = Cost Price - Selling Price = ₹1 - ₹0.75 = ₹0.25

⇒ Loss % = (Loss ÷ Cost Price) × 100 = (₹0.25 ÷ ₹1) × 100

⇒ Loss % = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25% loss.**

questions.question: The population of a district is 342000, out of which 228000 are males. 44% of the population is literate. If 59% males are literate, then what percentage of females are literate?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Population of district = 342000

Number of males = 228000

Percentage of literate population = 44%

Percentage of literate males = 59%

**Formula Used:**

Total literate population = (Percentage of literate population ÷ 100) × Total population

Literate males = (Percentage of literate males ÷ 100) × Number of males

Literate females = Total literate population − Literate males

Percentage of literate females = (Literate females ÷ Number of females) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total literate population = (44 ÷ 100) × 342000

⇒ Total literate population = 150480

⇒ Literate males = (59 ÷ 100) × 228000

⇒ Literate males = 134520

⇒ Literate females = Total literate population − Literate males

⇒ Literate females = 150480 − 134520

⇒ Literate females = 15960

⇒ Number of females = Total population − Number of males

⇒ Number of females = 342000 − 228000

⇒ Number of females = 114000

⇒ Percentage of literate females = (Literate females ÷ Number of females) × 100

⇒ Percentage of literate females = (15960 ÷ 114000) × 100

⇒ Percentage of literate females = 14%

**∴ The correct answer is 14%.**

questions.question: If 79% of first number is equal to four-ninths of second number, what is the ratio of first number to the second number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

79% of first number = four-ninths of second number

First number : Second number = ?

**Formula Used:**

Percentage formula: x% = x/100

Ratio formula: a/b = a : b

**Calculation:**

⇒ (79 ÷ 100) × First number = (4 ÷ 9) × Second number

⇒ 79 × First number = 400 × Second number

⇒ First number ÷ Second number = 400 ÷ 79

⇒ First number : Second number = 400 : 711

**∴ The correct answer is 400 : 711.**

questions.question: On the eve of new year, a branded washing machine is sold for ₹34,340 after allowing 15% discount. What is its marked price (in ₹)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = ₹34,340

Discount = 15%

**Formula Used:**

Marked Price (MP) = SP ÷ (1 - Discount Percentage)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Discount Percentage = 15% = 15 ÷ 100 = 0.15

⇒ MP = ₹34,340 ÷ (1 - 0.15)

⇒ MP = ₹34,340 ÷ 0.85

⇒ MP = ₹40,400

**∴ The correct answer is ₹40,400.**

questions.question: The sum of two numbers is 52 and their LCM is 651. The two numbers are:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum = 52

LCM = 651

**Formula used:**

a × b = gcd(a,b) × lcm(a,b)

gcd(a,b) divides both the sum and the lcm

**Calculation:**

⇒ Compute gcd(651, 52): 651 mod 52 = 27, 52 mod 27 = 25, 27 mod 25 = 2, 25 mod 2 = 1 ⇒ gcd = 1

⇒ Since gcd = 1, a × b = lcm = 651

⇒ Find factor pair of 651 whose sum is 52

⇒ 651 = 21 × 31 and 21 + 31 = 52

**The two numbers are 21 and 31.**

questions.question: Find the surface area of a sphere whose diameter is equal to 64 cm.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter = 64 cm

**Formula Used:**

Surface Area of a Sphere = 4 × π × r²

Radius (r) = Diameter ÷ 2

**Calculation:**

⇒ r = 64 ÷ 2 = 32 cm

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × (32)²

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × 1024

⇒ Surface Area = 4096π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 4096π cm².**

questions.question: Simplify the following: (1+cot ² theta)/(1+tan² theta)
questions.solution:

(1 + cot² θ) / (1 + tan² θ)

cot²θ + 1 = cosec²θ

tan²θ + 1 = sec²θ

**Calculation:**

⇒ (1 - sin²θ) / sin²θ

questions.question: A tradesman marks his goods at 24% above the cost price. He allows his customer a discount of 13% on the marked price. Find his profit percentage.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Discount = 13%

**Formula Used:**

MP ÷ CP = (100 + Profit) ÷ (100 − Discount)

**Calculation:**

Let CP = 100

So, MP = 124

⇒ MP ÷ CP = 124 ÷ 100

⇒ 124 ÷ 100 = (100 + Profit) ÷ (100 − 13)

⇒ 1.24 = (100 + Profit) ÷ 87

⇒ 100 + Profit = 1.24 × 87

⇒ 100 + Profit = 107.88

⇒ Profit = 107.88 − 100

⇒ Profit = 7.88%

**∴ The profit percentage is 7.88%.**

questions.solution:

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = (2 × Speed₁ × Speed₂) ÷ (Speed₁ + Speed₂)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Average Speed = (2 × 9 × 18) ÷ (9 + 18)

⇒ Average Speed = (2 × 162) ÷ 27

⇒ Average Speed = 324 ÷ 27

⇒ Average Speed = 12 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 12 km/hr.**

questions.question: The LCM of the numbers 2.6 and 0.084 is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Numbers: 2.6 and 0.084

**Formula Used:**

LCM of fractions = (LCM of numerators) ÷ (HCF of denominators)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Convert to fractions:

2.6 = 26/10

0.084 = 84/1000

⇒ Reduce the fractions:

26/10 = 13/5

84/1000 = 21/250

⇒ Numerators = 13 and 21

⇒ Denominators = 5 and 250

⇒ LCM(13, 21) = 273

⇒ HCF(5, 250) = 5

⇒ LCM = 273 ÷ 5

⇒ LCM = 54.6

**∴ The LCM of 2.6 and 0.084 is 54.6.**

questions.question: The average runs scored by a batsman in 23 matches is 43. In the next 10 matches, the batsman scored an average of 13 runs. Find his average runs scored (rounded off to two decimal places) in all the 33 matches.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average runs scored in 23 matches = 43

Average runs scored in next 10 matches = 13

Total number of matches = 33

**Formula Used:**

Total runs scored in matches = Average × Number of matches

Overall average = Total runs scored ÷ Total number of matches

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total runs scored in first 23 matches = 43 × 23 = 989

⇒ Total runs scored in next 10 matches = 13 × 10 = 130

⇒ Total runs scored in all matches = 989 + 130 = 1119

⇒ Overall average = 1119 ÷ 33 = 33.91

**∴ The correct answer is 33.91.**

questions.question: Pipe A can fill a tank in 16 hours, pipe B can fill the same tank in 21 hours and pipe C can fill the same tank in 11 hours. The time taken by them to fill the same tank if they operate together is::
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Pipe A fills the tank in 16 hours

Pipe B fills the tank in 21 hours

Pipe C fills the tank in 11 hours

**Formula Used:**

1-day work = 1 ÷ Time

Total time = 1 ÷ (Sum of individual rates)

**Calculation:**

⇒ A’s rate = 1/16

⇒ B’s rate = 1/21

⇒ C’s rate = 1/11

⇒ Combined rate = 1/16 + 1/21 + 1/11

⇒ LCM(16, 21, 11) = 3696

⇒ Convert each:

1/16 = 231/3696

1/21 = 176/3696

1/11 = 336/3696

⇒ Combined rate = (231 + 176 + 336) / 3696

⇒ Combined rate = 743 / 3696

⇒ Total time = 3696 ÷ 743

⇒ Total time =4(724)/(743) hours

**∴ They will fill the tank together in approximately 4(724)/(743) hours.**
